text: Lion's Mane & Ashwagandha: Lots of people take these for focus and stress, but I'd leave both out. People say these herbs left them with anhedonia (when nothing feels good anymore) and sexual dysfunction that persisted even after they stopped, in rare cases reported on forums and YouTube. Nobody has studied these effects in the two herbs yet, but regulators already warn that SSRIs and finasteride can leave the same kind behind.
section: A Complete Guide to Bio-De-Armoring, the warnings: a new item after the Cognitive Warning
reader: an adult with trauma reading the warnings at the top before starting, who may already take lion's mane or ashwagandha, or be thinking of adding them for focus or stress
